items.competency: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees (R.A. 6713)
items.stem: Under R.A. 6713 §7(d): An official accepts a ₱8,000 gift from a supplier with a pending bid. What is the proper action?

options.text: Refuse or return the gift and disclose it
Accept and donate the value later
Ask the supplier to reduce it below ₱1,000
Keep it if the bid is fair

items.reveal: Under §7(d), the proper action is to refuse or return the gift and disclose it.

items.competency: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees (R.A. 6713)
items.stem: Under R.A. 6713 §7(d): A staff member takes free tournament tickets from a bidding contractor. What is the proper action?

options.text: Accept because tickets are not cash
Decline the tickets and record the offer
Keep them if no one notices
Accept and share with the office

items.reveal: Under §7(d), the proper action is to decline the tickets and record the offer.

items.competency: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees (R.A. 6713)
items.stem: Under R.A. 6713 §7(b): A regulator discusses employment with a company they currently oversee. What is the proper action?

options.text: Accept if the start date is next month
Accept and inhibit only on the start day
Let a deputy sign the contract
Decline until separation and the cooling-off period ends

items.reveal: Under §7(b), the proper action is to decline until separation and the cooling-off period ends.

items.competency: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees (R.A. 6713)
items.stem: Under R.A. 6713 §7(c): An employee posts confidential bid prices on a personal account. What is the proper action?

options.text: Leave it because it is already public
Share it with other bidders for fairness
Delete it only if someone complains
Remove the post and report the disclosure

items.reveal: Under §7(c), the proper action is to remove the post and report the disclosure.

items.competency: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees (R.A. 6713)
items.stem: Under R.A. 6713 §4: A division chief uses a government vehicle every weekend for family trips. What is the proper action?

options.text: Use it only outside office hours
Continue if fuel is paid personally
Stop the personal use and reimburse the agency

items.reveal: Under §4, the proper action is to stop the personal use and reimburse the agency.

items.reveal: Under §4, the proper action is to refund the personal charges and stop the practice.

items.competency: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees (R.A. 6713)
items.stem: Under R.A. 6713 §7(a): A director sits on the panel promoting their spouse. What is the proper action?

options.text: Participate if the spouse is qualified
Ask the spouse to withdraw quietly
Inhibit from the panel and disclose the relationship
Stay but abstain from the vote only

items.reveal: Under §7(a), the proper action is to inhibit from the panel and disclose the relationship.

items.competency: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees (R.A. 6713)

Recommend but do not sign the appointment

items.reveal: Under §7(a), the proper action is to withdraw the recommendation and disclose the kinship.

items.stem: Under R.A. 6713 §8: An appointee files a SALN that omits a residential lot. What is the proper action?

Declare only the house, not the lot

items.reveal: Under §8, the proper action is to amend and file a complete SALN.

items.competency: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees (R.A. 6713)

items.reveal: Under §8, the proper action is to file immediately and explain the delay.

items.stem: Under R.A. 6713 §5: A records officer ignores a document request for 45 days. What is the proper action?

Wait until the requester follows up

items.reveal: Under §5, the proper action is to act on the request or issue a formal denial with legal basis.
